prompt.zh-CN: 【安全通知】安全与身份负责人宣布：员工无权阅读的内容一律禁止被代理引用，对外口径必须先经人工确认。
prompt.en-US: 【Security Notice】The Security / IAM lead announces that content the employee is not entitled to is strictly forbidden from agent quotes, and external customer-facing copy must wait for human confirmation.

prompt.zh-CN: 【上线压力】知识与IT负责人要求：知识代理必须先上线检索，权限闸门可以下一阶段再补。
prompt.en-US: 【Ship Pressure】The Head of Knowledge / IT requires the knowledge agent to ship retrieval first, with the permission gate allowed to wait for a later phase.

prompt.zh-CN: 【事故报告】知识库运营通报：代理曾编造引用，并且一次检索忽略了 ACL，把无权内容写进了回答。
prompt.en-US: 【Incident Report】Knowledge-base ops reports that the agent fabricated a citation, and one retrieval ignored ACL and wrote unauthorized content into the answer.

prompt.zh-CN: 【流程要求】知识库运营要求：每一次内部答案都必须带可打开的引用，对外口径不得由代理自行定稿。
prompt.en-US: 【Process Required】Knowledge-base ops requires every internal answer to carry an openable citation, and external wording must not be finalized by the agent alone.
